families.label: Pixel RML · entropy + smoothness
families.blurb: Classic regularised maximum likelihood: stay close to a Gaussian prior, penalise roughness.

families.label: Pixel RML · total variation
families.blurb: Prefers piecewise-flat images with sharp edges (compressed-sensing style).

families.label: Neural field · low-bandwidth Fourier features
families.blurb: Coordinate MLP; its spectral bias favours smooth structure at the array resolution.

families.label: Neural field · high-bandwidth Fourier features
families.blurb: Same MLP with higher-frequency features; free to place compact, super-resolved detail.

families.label: Deep image prior · CNN decoder
families.blurb: An untrained convolutional decoder: natural-image statistics come from the architecture.

families.label: Learned prior · VAE trained on rings only
families.blurb: A generative model trained on 24,000 simulated rings and crescents, none of which has a knot.

families.label: Learned prior · VAE trained on rings with knots
families.blurb: The same generative model trained on images half of which carry a compact knot outside the ring.
